rit_meaning: Size of metadata extracted from the PDF file, in bytes.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe metadata-section size; compatible numeric quantity, with CIC's observed -1 raw sentinel retained and separately audited.

rit_meaning: xref length as extracted from the file header.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe the Xref length/entry quantity; local maxima and numeric representation are compatible evidence, while CIC -1 remains an unverified raw sentinel.

rit_meaning: Number of characters in the file title.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe the number of title characters; compatible numeric character count, with CIC's raw -1 sentinel retained.

rit_meaning: Number of embedded files inside the PDF, as extracted from the header.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe a count of embedded files and use a numeric local representation; no unit conversion is required.

rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "trailer" in the PDF file.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe a count of PDF trailers and use numeric local representations.

rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/ObJStm" in the PDF file.
rationale: Both dictionaries describe stream objects (ObjStm) as a numeric count.
